description: INSERT(base, pos, len, insert) - Snowflake's string function: remove len characters from base starting at the 1-based pos and put insert in their place. A length of 0 inserts without removing anything, a position past the end appends, calls nest, a NULL base is NULL, and INSERT is a keyword (the INSERT statement) that also names this function, so the grammar allows it as a function name in any letter case. Converted 1:1 from functions/InsertFunctionTest (now retired).
